tools.name: inspect_live_show
tools.description: Read the current lot, exact all-in quote, public evidence, privacy receipt, aggregate host request, hold, and next available action. Use when arriving or after the page changes.

tools.name: set_evidence_requirements
tools.description: Publish the four product-evidence requirements this seller can act on: length range, visible-edge requirement, and repair-history policy. The schema accepts only those fields and changes no quote or hold.

minLengthCm.description: Minimum acceptable snowboard length in centimeters.

maxLengthCm.description: Maximum acceptable snowboard length in centimeters.

requireVisibleEdgeEvidence.description: Whether a visible close-up of the edges is required before a decision.

forbidPriorBaseRepair.description: Whether any disclosed prior base repair makes the lot incompatible.
